overview: SocializeX is a premium full-stack social media platform with a futuristic dark neon glassmorphism UI inspired by Instagram, Discord, X, and LinkedIn. Features real-time chat, AI-powered tools, user profiles, dynamic feeds, and an admin dashboard — built for production-level deployment.
features: Dark neon glassmorphism UI with animated gradients and hover effects
Social feed with posts, likes, comments, reposts, and emoji reactions
Real-time chat with typing indicators, read receipts, and group chats
AI caption generator, hashtag suggestions, and AI chatbot assistant
User profiles with followers/following, cover images, and activity history
Explore page with trending posts, suggested users, and smart search
Reels/short video section with interactive player
Admin dashboard with user management, analytics, and content moderation
Notifications system with live activity feed
Internet Identity authentication with role-based access control
Media uploads with object storage for avatars and post images
